home_intro: Nice of you to stop by. There's not much to see here yet. I spent way too much time making this sick logo, but I'm working on adding more content.
about_bio: I'm Johannes and I'm currently studying computer science at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology in Trondheim. I'm a developer with a passion for frontend. I love building stuff, especially if I get to make it look cool.
project_react_calendar_description: A modern, responsive calendar built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
project_oysteinaas_description: Landingpage for triathlete Øystein Aas (yes, we are brothers)
project_onlineweb_description: Website of NTNU's informatics student association
project_loginno_description: Website of student association for IT at NTNU in Gjøvik
project_healthtech_description: Bachelor's thesis for Aker Solutions that visualizes workers' noise, vibration and dust exposure
healthtech_cta_note: The demo runs on sample data. Switch between the operator and foreman views in the profile menu.
healthtech_summary: A dashboard prototype, developed as a bachelor's thesis at NTNU, that visualizes noise, vibration and dust exposure data from wearable sensors. Workers can track their own exposure against action and limit values, while foremen get an overview of their entire team.
healthtech_history_text: Day, week and month views show when limits were crossed.
healthtech_team_text: Foremen see the whole team at a glance and can drill into any person or exposure.
healthtech_alt_overview: Dust exposure overview with a daily chart and time spent above each limit
healthtech_alt_foreman: Foreman overview with team status and exposure breakdowns
healthtech_alt_week: Week view with hourly exposure status
healthtech_alt_month: Month view with daily exposure status
react_calendar_summary: A lightweight, flexible React calendar with customizable, color-coded categories.
react_calendar_multiday_text: Events spanning several days show up as one bar, even across weeks.
react_calendar_responsive_text: Works just as well on a phone.
react_calendar_alt_demo: The demo with events spanning several days
react_calendar_alt_mobile_dark: The demo on a phone in dark mode
